properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 1 at 8:38PM MDT until October 4 at 7:30AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Colorado...

Purgatoire River Near Purgatoire R near Las Animas affecting Bent
County.

For the Purgatoire River...including Purgatoire near Las Animas...
Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Purgatoire River near Purgatoire R near Las Animas.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Moderate Flood. Moderate agricultural
flooding occurs in low lying areas along the river.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:15 PM MDT Thursday the stage was 9.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:15 PM MDT Thursday was 9.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 10.8 feet
tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 10.5
feet on 08/19/2004.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Friday morning at 845 AM MDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL SUNDAY MORNING

properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 1 at 8:08PM MDT until October 2 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 33 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...The San Luis Valley.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 8 AM MDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The coldest readings will be across the
central portions of the valley floor.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

NWSheadline: FROST ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 3 AM TO 8 AM MDT FRIDAY
